fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-09-05 (afternoon, 16:25): Members of a chit group near Roja Park Main Street reported that the organiser stopped payouts, with the complainant owed about Rs. 1,20,000. The complaint was lodged by Bharath Babu (9000000482). A person named Hariharan Babu, associated with the number 9000000154, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. A witness, Ramesh Pandian, reachable on 9000000469, was mentioned in the complaint.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Organiser allegedly stopped payouts and became unreachable.
